title: От Матфея 4 — Matthew 4
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: Then the tempter came and said to him.
cases.explain: Искуситель is the subject of подошёл (came) → nominative.

cases.sentence: Дух повел Иисуса в пустыню для того, чтобы ему пройти искушение от ___.
cases.translation: The Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
cases.explain: от + genitive: от дьявола (by/from the devil).

cases.sentence: К нему приносили страдающих от самых различных ___.
cases.translation: They brought to him those suffering from many different diseases.

cases.sentence: Своим ___ повелит о тебе, и они понесут тебя на руках.
cases.translation: He will command his angels concerning you, and they will bear you up in their hands.
cases.explain: повелеть кому — 'to command someone' takes the dative: ангелам (to his angels).

cases.sentence: Затем дьявол поставил ___ на самый верх храма святого города.
cases.translation: Then the devil took Jesus to the highest point of the temple of the holy city.
cases.explain: поставить (кого) — the transitive verb governs the accusative: поставил Иисуса.

cases.sentence: Ни одним хлебом живет человек, но и каждым ___, исходящим из уст Божьих.
cases.translation: Man does not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.
cases.explain: жить чем — instrumental marks the means: словом (by a word).

cases.sentence: Иисус ходил по всей Галилее и учил в ___.
cases.translation: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in the synagogues.
cases.explain: в + prepositional (plural) for location: в синагогах (in the synagogues).

reading.ru: Затем Дух повел Иисуса в пустыню для того, чтобы ему пройти искушение от дьявола.
reading.question: Why was Jesus led into the wilderness?
options: To be tempted by the devil
To pray alone for a year
reading.correct: To be tempted by the devil
reading.explain: The Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

reading.ru: «Если ты сын Божий, то прикажи этим камням стать хлебом».
reading.question: What was the devil's first temptation to Jesus?
reading.explain: The devil first tempted Jesus to command stones to become bread.

reading.ru: Тогда дьявол привел его на очень высокую гору и показал ему все царства мира во всем их блеске.
reading.question: What did the devil show Jesus from the very high mountain?
options: All the kingdoms of the world in their splendor
reading.correct: All the kingdoms of the world in their splendor
reading.explain: The devil showed Jesus all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

reading.ru: Покинув Назарет, он поселился в Капернауме, который расположен на берегу озера в земле, принадлежавшей родам Завулона и Нефалима.
reading.question: After leaving Nazareth, where did Jesus settle?
reading.explain: Jesus left Nazareth and settled in Capernaum, by the sea.

reading.question: What did Jesus say to the fishermen brothers Simon and Andrew?
reading.explain: Jesus called the fishermen to come after him.

reading.ru: Слух о нем распространился по всей Сирии, и к нему приносили страдающих от самых различных болезней, испытывающих сильные боли, одержимых демонами, людей, подверженных припадкам, парализованных, и он их исцелял.
reading.question: What happened as news of Jesus spread through Syria?
options: People brought the sick and suffering to him and he healed them
People fled from him in fear
reading.correct: People brought the sick and suffering to him and he healed them
reading.explain: As his fame spread, people brought their sick to Jesus and he healed them.
